description: The operation interface an egress_registry or ingress_registry entry implements, copied whole and identified by the digest of its JCS canonical form (architecture §3.16.2, §3.16.7; implementation §8.1). The fields and the response of each operation are schemas in the subset of implementation §8.2, which the binary checks beyond this document.

protocol.description: https, or the protocol of an own adapter (implementation §8.3, §8.7). Its range is that of the deployed Integration Sidecar, which the Global Configuration schema fixes.

fields.description: The fields, as an object schema with properties (implementation §8.2).

response.description: The shape of the response, as an object schema with properties; in ingress, only when the protocol expects a reply.

body.description: In egress, whether the call and the response carry a body (architecture §3.16.2).

bodies.description: In ingress, whether the message brings bodies (architecture §3.16.7).

context.description: In ingress, the message's context window (architecture §3.16.7, implementation §8.3).

https.description: The declarative mapping, when protocol is https (implementation §8.3).

path.description: Under the root of the target, with a {name} segment per path field.

fields.description: Where each field goes: in is path, query, header or json, and at is the parameter's or the header's name, or a JSON Pointer into the request's JSON body.

response.description: Where each field of the response comes from: from is json, with a JSON Pointer over the body, or header, with a name.

verification.description: In ingress through a listener, how the sender is verified (implementation §8.6).
